description: This file defines serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for the ArrayList class in the Orleans Serialization framework. It includes a serializer class, a surrogate structure, and a deep copier.

classes.name: ArrayListCodec
classes.description: Serializer for ArrayList that converts to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: ArrayListSurrogate
classes.description: A surrogate structure used for serializing ArrayList, containing an object array of values.

classes.name: ArrayListCopier
classes.description: Provides deep copy functionality for ArrayList instances.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ArrayListSurrogate back into an ArrayList.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ArrayList into its surrogate representation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ArrayList.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Deep copies elements from one ArrayList to another.
